instruction.text: Sort the units of length from the longest to the shortest.
How many millimetres make one centimetre? Choose the correct answer on the right side.

end.text: Correct. 1`cm` is the same length as 10`mm`. This means that 1`cm` is ten times longer than 1`mm`.
end.sound: Correct. 1 cm is the same length as 10 mm. This means that 1 cm is ten times longer than 1 mm.

hint.sound: 1 cm is the same length as 10 mm.

atoms.b: To convert a length given in centimetres to millimetres, the measurement needs to be multiplied by ((1 ++10 100)).

instruction.text: The height of an apple is 8 cm. How tall is the apple in millimetres? Choose the correct answer.

atoms.sound: 8 cm is the same length as 80 mm.

instruction.text: The length of a banana is 23 cm. How long is the banana in millimetres? Choose the correct answer.

atoms.sound: 23 cm is the same length as 230 mm.

instruction.text: The height of a strawberry is 3 cm. How tall is the strawberry in millimetres? Choose the correct answer.

atoms.sound: 3 cm is the same length as 30 mm.

instruction.text: The length of a slice of watermelon is 11 cm. How long is the slice in millimetres? Choose the correct answer.

atoms.sound: 11 cm is the same length as 110 mm.
